app.title: Color Names
app.author: akkartik
app.description: A lightweight JSON/CSV dataset of color names and their RGB/HSL values, with a small CLI to query the data.
proposed_tests: clone the repo and run npm install
execute the CLI with a known color query and verify output
import the JS/TS module and check that getColor('skyblue') returns expected RGB
